description: The new policy replaces the 2021 Data Center Policy, which expired in January this year.
body_lead: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, on Monday approved the Uttar Pradesh Data Center Policy 2026, targeting over Rs 2 lakh crore in investments and the addition of 2 GW of data centre capacity as the state looks to position itself as a leading green and AI-ready data centre hub. The new policy replaces the 2021 Data Center Policy, which expired in January this year. The government said it aims to strengthen Uttar Pradesh's digital infrastructure, accelerate innovation and make the state a globally competitive technology destination.
